  ],
  "reasons": [
    "The stem says the product falls short of expectations and asks about obtaining relief. E5.1 identifies the right to seek redressal as the right to get relief in that situation.",
    "E5.1 distinguishes being heard on a complaint from getting relief; E4.1 describes choice among products; E5.2 describes education as acquiring knowledge and awareness of available relief."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Consumer Protection",
  "syllabus_topic": "Consumer rights: distinguishing the right to seek redressal from the rights to be heard, choose, and consumer education.",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "The product falls short of the seller’s stated expectations.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "The buyer seeks relief, and the question asks which right most directly addresses obtaining it.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "The consumer-rights distinctions identify seeking redressal with getting relief, hearing with complaint and being heard, choice with selecting among products, and education with knowledge and awareness.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": [
        "E4.1",
        "E5.1",
        "E5.2"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Treat relief as the complaint channel: E5.1 says dissatisfied consumers may complain and be heard, but separately assigns actual relief to seek-redressal.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "If the issue were selecting among product varieties, choice would apply; here the buyer seeks relief after a product falls short.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "If relief meant learning which remedies exist, education could inform the buyer; the stem asks about obtaining relief, not learning about it.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [
    "“Seller’s stated expectations” is slightly less textbook-like than “the consumer’s expectations,” but the intended meaning is clear."
  ],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Consumer rights are expressly named in the Consumer Protection syllabus unit; the question tests a central distinction."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "A valid four-option objective case-application question; the supplied authenticated comparators use longer passage-based marketing cases."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "One-step concept application, within the supplied exemplars’ classification demand."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "The alternatives test identifiable confusions among hearing, redressal, choice, and consumer education."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "application",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": [
      "cuet2024-business_studies-bookA-q41",
      "cuet2024-business_studies-bookA-q44",
      "cuet2024-business_studies-bookA-q45"
    ]
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E5.1",
      "premise_quote": "The consumer has a right to get relief against unfair trade practice of restrictive trade practices or unscrupulous exploitation in case the product or a service falls short of his expectations.",
      "reason": "The excerpt directly links getting relief after a product falls short of expectations to seeking redressal."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Right to be heard",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E5.1",
      "premise_quote": "4. Right to be heard: The consumer has a right to file a complaint and to be heard in case of dissatisfaction with a good or a service. It is because of this reason that many enlightened business firms have set up their own consumer service and grievance cells. Many consumer organisations are also working towards this direction and helping consumers in redressal of their grievances. 5. Right to seek redressal: The consumer has a right to get relief against unfair trade practice of restrictive trade practices or unscrupulous exploitation in case the product or a service falls short of his expectations.",
      "reason": "The excerpt assigns complaint and hearing to this right, while separately assigning getting relief to seeking redressal."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Right to choose",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E4.1",
      "premise_quote": "The consumer has the freedom to access variety of products at competitive prices. This implies that the marketers should offer a wide variety of products in terms of quality, brand, prices, size, etc. and allow the consumer to make a choice from amongst these.",
      "reason": "The excerpt describes choosing among product varieties; the stem asks about relief after a product falls short."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Right to consumer education",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E5.2",
      "premise_quote": "The consumer has a right to acquire knowledge and to be a well informed consumer throughout life. He should be aware about his rights and the reliefs available to him in case of a product or service falling short of his expectations.",
      "reason": "Education concerns knowledge and awareness of available relief, not obtaining the relief requested in the stem."
    }
  ]
}
